instruction: Candid outdoor medium photograph of a sunny, grassy park surrounded by lush trees. In the left foreground, the woman in the dark blue t-shirt (R4) is seen from a three-quarters back view with her arms outstretched to the right. On the right, the woman with the afro (R6) in a red t-shirt faces left, smiling joyfully with her arms wide open as she moves to embrace her. In the background, the man in the red polo (R3) and the woman in the black beanie (R5) watch happily, while the bald man (R2) is partially visible on the left. Bright, natural sunlight filters through the trees, creating a warm, vibrant atmosphere with rich green and red tones.
elements: R6 moves toward R4 with arms wide open to embrace R4
